display.purpose: Hero and page-hero headlines only; Cormorant 300, ceiling ~88px.

title.purpose: Card and detail headings in Cormorant 400.

body.purpose: All running copy in Inter; measure capped 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Form labels, nav, the single earned kicker; uppercase Inter 600, rationed.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Faint gold-tinted glow under raised cards and the hero stat cluster, paired with a small translateY on hover.

shadows.name: nav-veil
shadows.purpose: Scrolled navbar only, alongside backdrop-filter blur(12px).

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default state transition for hover, color, and border changes.

motion.name: ease-nav
motion.purpose: Navbar veil and mobile menu slide.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The gold-seal CTA; the one strongly colored action on a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #A07828; color: #FBFBFA; padding: 14px 32px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #C9A84C; color: #1A1712; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8A6620; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action; quiet until hovered, then warms to gold.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: #1A1712; padding: 14px 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(160,120,40,0.35); border-radius: 6px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #A07828; color: #A07828; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8A6620; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Venture Card
components.description: Flat surface card with hairline border and a gold-tinted hover lift; holds one venture.
components.html:
Healthcare

Pharmacy Chain

Three established pharmacies serving their communities with trusted care.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #F4F4F2; border: 1px solid #DEDEDB; border-radius: 8px; padding: 36px 32px; transition: border-color 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(201,168,76,0.4); transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 2px 24px rgba(160,120,40,0.08); } .ds-card-sector { display: block; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8A6620; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 400; color: #1A1712; margin: 0 0 14px; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.75; color: #5E564B; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labelled field on a sunken surface; gold-tint border on focus, no glow.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5E564B; } .ds-input { background: #ECECE9; border: 1px solid #DEDEDB; border-radius: 6px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #1A1712; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5E564B; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(201,168,76,0.5); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Pill tag for venture brand names; the tinted variant signals venture state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 6px 16px; border: 1px solid #DEDEDB; border-radius: 999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #5E564B; } .ds-chip-active { background: rgba(22,163,74,0.10); border-color: rgba(22,163,74,0.25); color: #15803D; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 10px; }

components.name: Navbar Link
components.description: Uppercase nav link with a center-out gold underline on hover/active.
components.html: HomeAboutContact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 40px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5E564B; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.25s ease; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -4px; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px; background: #A07828; transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform 0.25s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link-active { color: #1A1712; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

narrative.overview: One calm, well-bred voice speaking across very different businesses: pharmacies, a fuel station, and a healthcare-technology platform read as facets of a single house. Established, refined, quietly confident; premium without flash. The system is light and spacious on a true near-white surface (not cream) with a deep warm-ink anchor for hero moments. Cormorant Garamond carries headlines with letterpress poise; Inter does the plain, legible body work. Warmth lives in the gold accent and the type, never in a beige background. Components are crisp and modern: hairline borders, tight radii, restraint over ornament.
keyCharacteristics: True near-white surface with a deep warm-ink anchor; warmth carried by gold and serif type, never by a beige body.
Serif display (Cormorant) against sans body (Inter): heritage meeting plain confidence.
Gold used as a rare seal (<=10% of any screen), not a wash.
Crisp components: hairline borders, 6-8px radii, flat at rest.
Bilingual-ready (Arabic / English) and AA-accessible by construction.

rules.name: The One Seal Rule
rules.body: Gold appears on at most 10% of any screen. It marks the single thing that matters on a view. A second competing gold element breaks the seal.

rules.name: The No-Cream Rule
rules.body: The body surface is Paper White at chroma <=0.006 and lightness >=0.96, or the Ink Surface espresso. The warm-neutral cream/sand/parchment band (OKLCH L 0.84-0.97, C 0.01-0.06, hue 40-100) is forbidden as a background.

rules.name: The Earned Kicker Rule
rules.body: The small uppercase tracked label is allowed at most once per page, and only when it names a real system. Stacking it above every section is the AI eyebrow tell and is forbidden.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Exactly two families: Cormorant for display/title, Inter for everything else. Hierarchy comes from scale and weight, not new fonts.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards, inputs, and panels are flat at rest, defined by a hairline border and tonal steps. Shadow appears only on hover or for the two signature elements.

rules.name: The Rare-Glass Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter is permitted only on the scrolled navbar and mobile overlay. Decorative glass cards are forbidden.

dos: Do keep the body on Paper White (#FBFBFA) or the Ink Surface espresso (#16130E); carry warmth through gold and Cormorant, never the background.
Do ration gold to <=10% of any screen (The One Seal Rule).
Do use Deep Gold (#8A6620) for small gold text and links on light; Antique Gold alone fails 4.5:1 at body size.
Do keep Muted Ink (#5E564B) for secondary copy; verify every text/background pair against AA.
Do design for Arabic / English from the start: logical CSS properties, an RTL-safe layout, and a language toggle.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion alternative.
Do lead sections with a strong Cormorant Headline; let scale and weight carry hierarchy.
Do earn trust with specifics: name the pharmacies, the sectors, the real operations.
donts: Don't use cream / sand / parchment backgrounds (warm-neutral band OKLCH L 0.84-0.97, C 0.01-0.06, hue 40-100); it is the #1 AI tell and the brand's stated anti-reference.
Don't stack a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section; one earned kicker per page maximum.
Don't ship grids of identical icon + heading + text cards repeated endlessly.
Don't lean on the big-number hero-stats template (3 / 1 / 3) as the centerpiece.
Don't use gradient text or decorative gradient banners.
Don't use glassmorphism beyond the scrolled navbar and mobile overlay.
Don't use marketing buzzwords or salesy, aggressive CTAs.
Don't drift toward cold navy-and-blue SaaS styling or a dark hero with gradient blobs.
Don't introduce a third typeface or a second accent hue.
